description: This file implements the core functions for the Web Resource Owner Object, including creation, deletion, object enrollment, and initialization. It defines the constructor WebRooCreate, destructor WebRooRemove, enrollment WebRooEnrollObjects, and setup WebRooInitialize functions, handling object lifecycle, associated interfaces, and default property setup.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE WebRooCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a Web Resource Owner Object, allocating memory and setting up function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the Web Resource Owner Object, performing cleanup such as freeing interfaces and locks.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the RCP interface object, and enrolls associated objects for the Web Resource Owner.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRooInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting member functions, configuring properties, and preparing synchronization primitives.
